review.kind: M1 manual source classification, not runtime privacy certification
review.scope: First-party source under ruyi-workbench and mcp; generated/runtime/vendor/test directories excluded
review.instructions: Review changed source and call relations before manually updating fingerprints. No automatic classification refresh.

unknown.purpose: Conservative unresolved candidate; never evidence of protection
unknown.productionRelation: Source lexical candidate; full runtime dispatch is unresolved
unknown.evidence: Manual M1 review: static analysis limitation retained explicitly; see AUDIT.md

capability.purpose: Imported implementation may perform further sends
capability.productionRelation: Import capability, not a separate physical send
capability.evidence: Transport imports recorded independently from send sites; dependency internals are outside first-party source analysis

dynamic.transport: computed call / embedded code / shell / runtime import
dynamic.purpose: Dynamic dispatch can reach additional services, files or processes
dynamic.productionRelation: Computed call, browser evaluate, dynamic import or shell command; unresolved downstream graph
dynamic.evidence: M1 source review leaves these unknown; source fingerprints only request re-review

regex.productionRelation: Reviewed exec candidates are RegExp calls; no child_process.exec call exists in scanned current sources
regex.evidence: Review of all exec candidates; actual process exports spawn/execFile/spawnSync/execFileSync are separate records

local-callback.transport: local callback / async context / UI action
local-callback.purpose: Run local callback or in-memory transformation
local-callback.productionRelation: Same-named run/save/lookup/goto methods are local functions or AsyncLocalStorage/PrivacyGateway calls
local-callback.evidence: Source owners and first-party definitions reviewed; no direct transport in this candidate

ui-api.transport: same-origin fetch / UI API wrapper / event stream
ui-api.purpose: UI sends to workbench or loads same-origin locale/assets
ui-api.productionRelation: public net.apiRaw and direct /api calls; backend onward egress is separately classified
ui-api.evidence: First-party call-site review; no claim that a generic dynamic URL is restricted by the fetch primitive itself

audio-node.productionRelation: composer-voice AudioContext graph setup; no socket transport
audio-node.evidence: connect is an audio processing method, while audio POST paths use UI API and backend media records

ui-preview.purpose: Preview attachments or render local popup
ui-preview.productionRelation: createObjectURL or window.open blank page; download sites separately recorded
ui-preview.evidence: Object URL allocation is not network transmission

export.productionRelation: downloadRawEvents/exportSession/exportMemory/mermaid export; export may retain original local view
export.evidence: Source export builders have no common recipient-specific disclosure contract; downloads are external copies rather than network sends

credential-export.productionRelation: privacy-settings recovery export calls credential recovery API
credential-export.evidence: Encrypted credential backup is distinct from full work-data encryption or recipient disclosure; not labelled protected by this prototype

file-boundary.recipient: runtime file path (local, removable or network share unresolved)
file-boundary.purpose: Persist or export bytes at a caller-selected/internal path
file-boundary.productionRelation: writeFile/copyFile/createWriteStream/Python save/Office Save families; paths may be internal stores or user destinations
file-boundary.evidence: M1 cannot prove final filesystem target or downstream application disclosure; not counted as external network

process.purpose: Execute helper, shell, editor, browser or CLI
process.productionRelation: cp.spawn/execFile variants; Python subprocess/os.startfile; desktop Process.Start; delegates can independently access network
process.evidence: No OS network sandbox proven by this source-only prototype; local executable does not imply protected downstream egress

cli.purpose: Run agent task or CLI terminal command
cli.evidence: PrivacyGateway.assertSupported/assertCliAllowed refuse unsupported protected mode on existing entry paths, but off-mode CLI and future child/plugin sends remain unmanaged; no managed-mode delivery claimed

mcp.purpose: Call tools and receive MCP messages
mcp.productionRelation: Managed native main/child turns bind MCP stdio/HTTP/SSE dispatch to the configured client, policy epoch, turn and offered resource handles; one shared result encoder projects model-facing text and bounded resource-update metadata. CLI keeps existing tools and does not offer the native-turn resource tool.
mcp.evidence: M2-7 source review plus privacy-managed-mcp.e2e.js final 483 assertions twice. Unknown services receive no private-reference restoration grant. Independent consumers, server-internal network, binary resources and remote unsubscribe acknowledgement remain outside this classification.

model.productionRelation: providerModelPostOnce physical POST; four business entries providerPostJsonOnce, probeProviderCompletion, openAiStreamOnce shared by runOpenAiTurn/runSubAgentCore, and singleSummaryCall; see four-entry table
model.evidence: Each business send reaches providerModelPostOnce, withPolicy preserves active scope or auxiliary fallback and binds OFF without creating a scope: await PrivacyGateway.beforeModelRequest, JSON.stringify, assertPolicyAvailable, then fetch without another await. Scope/alias reuse, OFF-to-ON and revision races, persistence failure and three protocols are exercised by privacy-model-send-boundary.e2e.js; recipient disclosure and media policy remain separate

provider-metadata.productionRelation: fetchOpenAiModels, probeNetwork, fetchProxyModels; URL/headers originate from configured providers
provider-metadata.evidence: Not chat body; existing credential scrubbing protects displays, not a universal recipient policy

toolbox-local.purpose: Probe, stop/unload or health check service
toolbox-local.evidence: Constructed 127.0.0.1 or locally supplied health host; service own sends are delegated and not covered

kimi-local.purpose: Talk to locally launched Kimi bridge
kimi-local.productionRelation: kimiHttp builds http://127.0.0.1:${port}${pathname}; server process classified CLI
kimi-local.evidence: Loopback hop does not protect Kimi upstream sends

media.purpose: Transcribe audio or maintain stream session
media.productionRelation: 13b-api-domain-routes audioStreamUpstream -> for non-DELETE assertMediaAllowed(await readConfig()) -> build headers -> final synchronous policy check -> fetch
media.evidence: Non-DELETE PCM chunks re-read configuration and perform a final synchronous policy check immediately before fetch. Read publication generations prevent a stale config read from replacing a newly committed policy. DELETE remains bodyless session cleanup. Actual loopback regression covers mode changes and cleanup; recipient contracts and local audio sanitization remain outside this fix.

web.recipient: requested website / search backend / configured proxy / DNS resolver
web.purpose: Search, fetch, download or issue HTTP tool requests
web.productionRelation: webFetch/httpGetGuarded/httpRequest/deepseekWebRequest/builtinSearch/webSearchViaBackend -> openHttpRequest -> direct/proxy/TLS; DNS has its own metadata disclosure
web.evidence: SSRF/permission and credential handling exist, but no common recipient-specific outbound privacy contract; authorized original tool arguments can leave host

acc-web.transport: Python urllib opener / pinned socket / DNS
acc-web.evidence: Pinned-IP SSRF checks are not privacy projection; standalone ACC process has no host model privacy scope

acc-browser.recipient: browser page, remote origin and page scripts
acc-browser.productionRelation: _ensure_browser connects to CDP or launches browser; browser_open goto; browser_evaluate delegates code
acc-browser.evidence: Browser can send independently through page scripts, navigation, extension state or injected JavaScript; no per-recipient isolation proved

bots.purpose: Discover platform identity, obtain token and deliver reply
bots.productionRelation: ExternalChannelDelivery.post and discovery request/probe; 13w bots/outbox call sendReply
bots.evidence: Identity/receipt/idempotency and bounded body handling do not constitute recipient-specific privacy projection

bot-gateway.purpose: Forward public webhook ingress to local workbench
bot-gateway.productionRelation: external-bot-gateway createGateway validates local upstream then http(s).request
bot-gateway.evidence: Ingress relay is not outbound bot reply or model request; listener exposure is a separate deployment concern

acc-server.purpose: Return desktop tool data to MCP consumer
acc-server.productionRelation: ACC server main invokes mcp.run(transport=stdio); library writes not visible as first-party socket calls
acc-server.evidence: Independent ACC consumer receives original desktop data; connecting to workbench does not establish a separate authenticated protected consumer scope

browser-dom.recipient: browser-selected origin or local Blob/data/same-origin resource
browser-dom.purpose: Render content, create a preview or activate a user navigation
browser-dom.productionRelation: public .src/.href/.srcdoc/.innerHTML and setAttribute src/href/srcdoc; includes renderMarkdownInto and file-browser iframe preview
browser-dom.evidence: index.html CSP restricts img-src to self/data/blob and connect-src to self; ordinary Markdown remote images are blocked by that CSP. Sanitizer alone allows http(s) href/src. External activated links and delegated desktop browser use need separate destination review; dynamic markup is not proven harmless by lexical inspection.

workbench-mcp-output.transport: workbench independent MCP server stdout JSON-RPC
workbench-mcp-output.recipient: independent consumer of workbench startMcp stdio server
workbench-mcp-output.purpose: Return workbench MCP tools/resources/errors and publish progress notifications
workbench-mcp-output.productionRelation: 13-http-router startMcp dispatches to three stdio relays, each writing its own output -> process.stdout.write (13af InternalMcpRelay.startRelay is the one classified here; 13ac consumer relay and 13ad memory relay are classified separately; the in-process sendMcp/sendMcpNotification server was removed in 3.1); initialize/tools-list/tools-call/resources-list/resources-read/unknown-method/error and timer progress paths; distinct from managed MCP clients and independent ACC server
workbench-mcp-output.evidence: tools/resources list hide unsupported capabilities with privacy on; tools-call rechecks external-tool-result after execution, resources-read checks external-resource and masks config; catch rechecks external-error. the relay output serializers (the removed sendMcp path included) have no authenticated connection-bound privacy scope or common final disclosure contract. Off-mode may return original text/image results; initialization/progress/errors have separate behavior. Existing conditional refusal is not protected MCP delivery.

process-stdout.recipient: parent process or redirected stdout consumer
process-stdout.purpose: Emit process output outside its address space
process-stdout.productionRelation: First-party stdout.write site; workbench MCP serializers have a separate dedicated contract
process-stdout.evidence: Output may be logging/help/status or protocol data; no generic process-output privacy projection is proved by this source inventory.

audio-transcription.purpose: Transcribe audio or warm up ASR provider
audio-transcription.productionRelation: 05-claude-engine transcribeAudioViaProvider -> initial media check -> optional toolbox/config awaits -> original audio payload -> final synchronous policy check -> fetch
audio-transcription.evidence: The previous TOCTOU after toolbox setup/config hydration is fixed by a final synchronous policy check before fetch and generation-guarded config publication. privacy-audio-send-boundary.e2e.js tests basic/enhanced/strict switches, late real hydration and zero audio delivery to an actual loopback receiver. This does not implement local ASR, a recipient disclosure contract, or withdrawal of requests already submitted.

privacy-drive-probe.transport: fixed local Windows PowerShell child / stdin
privacy-drive-probe.purpose: Classify drive roots before probing a private file destination
privacy-drive-probe.productionRelation: PrivacyLocalDriveProbe.query validates and deduplicates root letters; start spawns a fixed script and pump writes only A-Z comma-separated roots
privacy-drive-probe.evidence: Reviewed 03b fixed script, strict reply grammar, lazy bounded queue, cancellation/deadlines and live ChildProcess cleanup; no model/body/secret file path is passed. This is local recipient classification, not process/network isolation or universal disclosure protection

text-export.transport: authenticated source-bound artifact to browser download or clipboard
text-export.recipient: user selected file destination or local clipboard
text-export.purpose: Explicit text or Mermaid export copy
text-export.productionRelation: Shared prepare/derive/validate loop serves text exports and canonical Mermaid source/SVG/PNG; ON defaults to projection, OFF and per-action plaintext remain intentional copies
text-export.evidence: M2 text/Mermaid/clipboard source reviews and scoped evidence. Clipboard write/writeText candidates are now enumerated; intentional plaintext/OFF exports retain this conservative classification. Source inventory is not complete runtime or OS/manual-copy protection proof.
text-export.runtimeEvidence: privacy-text-export.e2e.js 55 and privacy-mermaid-export.e2e.js 87 final assertions twice; clipboard sink detection remains a separately tracked inventory gap until M2-6b3

clipboard.recipient: user OS clipboard and permitted readers
clipboard.productionRelation: Canonical sources use host prepare/validate proofs; missing-source copies require authoritative usable OFF and literal-only proof. Boot copies fixed safe diagnostics only. Reservation is not an authorization boundary; explicit plaintext and OFF copies intentionally preserve source text.
clipboard.evidence: M2-6b3 manual source and candidate review; actual API, Edge and Windows clipboard receiver checks are recorded in docs/optimization-plan/evidence/privacy-m2-clipboard-copy.json. Manual selection/Ctrl+C and arbitrary OS readers are outside this application-button contract.

management-clipboard.recipient: owner-selected setup destination through OS clipboard
management-clipboard.productionRelation: Only reviewed external-bot setup callback/pairing and provider connector template controls; original management authority/expiry/revocation remains with their existing owners.
management-clipboard.evidence: Manual review of these exact callers. Preserve configuration bytes; this exception conveys no conversation source or model disclosure authority.

mcp-credential-setup.productionRelation: Only mountMcpConsumers explicit create action downloads the dedicated token; the list cannot recover it. Exact user-chosen grant, revocation and existing permission floor remain authoritative.
mcp-credential-setup.evidence: M2-8 owner and independent source review plus actual setup/download/revoke browser journey. The setup credential is intentionally preserved; it is not conversation disclosure or a work-data recovery package.

mcp-credential-blob.purpose: Construct the explicit initial setup download
mcp-credential-blob.productionRelation: This exact href is assigned only from the locally constructed configuration Blob URL. The subsequent intentional credential download is separately classified as bypassed.
mcp-credential-blob.evidence: Manual review of the exact URL construction and assignment. This proves no generic dynamic href, remote URL or third-party application behavior; revoking the Blob URL does not erase an already downloaded file.

mcp-authenticated-loopback.purpose: Dedicated consumer relay or active internal CLI verification
mcp-authenticated-loopback.productionRelation: post/lease target exact 127.0.0.1 and carry only the dedicated consumer token. Lease accepts LF acknowledgement/heartbeat and bounded exact update envelopes for the two fixed resource URIs; the relay shares its output encoder and applies local response pause/drain handling. verifyInternal retains the real inherited management token plus active registered CLI owner/session check. Discovery contains no secret; the consumer relay never reads runtime.json.
mcp-authenticated-loopback.evidence: Manual review of all three exact request sites and real relay/restart/CLI owner tests. Internal verification is token plus registered owner/session, not OS caller-PID proof; same-account host/discovery tampering and third-party client networking remain outside this boundary.

mcp-authenticated-text.transport: authenticated host result relayed to MCP stdio
mcp-authenticated-text.productionRelation: Seven existing file tools and two fixed resources intersect the existing permission floor and immutable workspace grant. One URI template expands only to those granted fixed resources. Connection-owned subscriptions use the existing single-flight heartbeat; updates contain only a whitelisted server-fixed URI protocol routing field, with the empty body projected and final policy/grant/source/lease/entry guards. RPC and notification stdio output share one encoder. Complete resource/tool text is projected before formatting.
mcp-authenticated-text.evidence: M2-8a and M2-8b manual source and exact candidate review; scoped receiver evidence is recorded per batch. No binary/media, arbitrary file URI or template, unrelated subscriptions, arbitrary tool, uncredentialed consumer access, OS isolation or control of the receiving application is claimed. Fixed metadata updates may repeat across a post-write invalidation; no business operation is replayed.

internal-mcp-execution-loopback.purpose: Dispatch default internal MCP through the single registered CLI execution owner
internal-mcp-execution-loopback.productionRelation: The stdio child targets literal 127.0.0.1 and one fixed route with a fresh per-execution capability. serve checks the active main or node owner before reading its bounded body, nested tool dispatch and output. It does not give the child an independent disk owner.
internal-mcp-execution-loopback.evidence: Manual source review of 13af forward/handle and inherited launch configuration. The transport does not retry and drains accepted RPCs on EOF. This does not certify downstream tools, a global migration drain, OS isolation, same-account tampering resistance or independent client networking.

desktop-lifetime-ipc.transport: Windows named pipe (\\.\pipe\ruyi-desktop-<64 hex>) newline JSON
desktop-lifetime-ipc.purpose: Register serve/maintenance/successor roles, report serving/deferred/finished/uncertain and transfer lifetime grants
desktop-lifetime-ipc.productionRelation: 13ax DesktopLifetime connect/open/request/issue/serving/transfer/reportUncertain/receive; 13-http-router startServer and 14-main maintenance roles call DesktopLifetimeHooks.connect before serving
desktop-lifetime-ipc.evidence: 151 3F source review: pipe names must match ruyi-desktop-<64 hex> from the removed bootstrap environment descriptor, replies are shape/sequence checked and issued pipes/caps are single-use. No conversation, model or work-data body is written to the pipe. Same-account pipe squatting and OS isolation are not proven by this classification.

memory-cli-loopback.purpose: Memory CLI stdio relay forwards workbench_memory_list/read to the host
memory-cli-loopback.productionRelation: 13ad MemoryCliRelay startRelay post: literal 127.0.0.1, RUYI_MEMORY_CAP 64-hex capability, bounded body/result; host handle re-checks the live CLI or node grant, PrivacyGateway.assertSupported(config, cli) and the two-tool allow list
memory-cli-loopback.evidence: 151 3F source review of startRelay/handle. The relay deletes inherited WCW/internal MCP tokens before serving. Local hop only; what the CLI does with the returned memory is classified by memory-cli-output.

memory-cli-output.recipient: Claude/Kimi CLI process that launched the memory relay, and its upstream model/plugins
memory-cli-output.purpose: Return read-only memory tool results to the agent CLI
memory-cli-output.productionRelation: 13ad MemoryCliRelay startRelay output for initialize/ping/tools-list/tools-call; only reachable while the issuing CLI execution owner or agent-run node is current
memory-cli-output.evidence: 151 3F source review. The host refuses protected privacy mode for CLI via PrivacyGateway.assertSupported(config, cli); in OFF mode memory text leaves through the unmanaged CLI path exactly like the cli group. Not labelled protected or model-only.

semantic-runtime-child.recipient: local semantic runtime worker (bundled ONNX/transformers) or its resident proxy helper
semantic-runtime-child.purpose: Encode texts for local semantic retrieval scoring
semantic-runtime-child.productionRelation: 06hb SemanticRuntimeClient encode writes to the spawned worker; 13-http-router builds the command with an environment allow list plus HF_HUB_OFFLINE/TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE; resident-proxy*.cjs forward bootstrap and request bytes to their C# host helper over stdin
semantic-runtime-child.evidence: 151 3F source review: worker.cjs denyNetwork replaces fetch, http(s).request/get, net/tls connect before importing the runtime and sets allowRemoteModels=false/local_files_only. This is in-process best effort, not an OS network sandbox; native addons and the C# CreateProcessW launch are not enumerated by the lexical scanner.

semantic-resident-control.recipient: owned resident proxy host helper control pipe
semantic-resident-control.purpose: Request orderly stop/drain of the resident semantic helper
semantic-resident-control.productionRelation: resident-proxy*.cjs createSpawner connect=net.createConnection and requestStop connect to the helper-announced control pipe
semantic-resident-control.evidence: 151 3F source review: control messages carry stop/lifecycle fields only; texts travel on stdin (semantic-runtime-child).

semantic-model-download.transport: HTTPS GET (global fetch) plus npm ci child
semantic-model-download.purpose: Developer/packaging-time staging of the semantic runtime and pinned model files
semantic-model-download.productionRelation: semantic-runtime/install.cjs CLI only (node install.cjs --source --out); not required by server.js; package-offline.ps1 bundles a verified source and refuses runtime downloads
semantic-model-download.evidence: 151 3F source review: no user, session or credential data in the request; files are verified against the pinned lock afterwards. Network egress that does not pass the privacy gateway by design.

work-data-package-download.transport: explicit browser download of a same-origin package Blob
work-data-package-download.purpose: Save the work-data backup package produced by an enable/export operation
work-data-package-download.productionRelation: work-data-settings.js savePackage after GET /api/work-data/results/<id>/package (13ah downloadPackage -> 13au capturePackage under maintenance admission)
work-data-package-download.evidence: 151 3F source review: only after an explicit button press for a 48-hex result id, size checked against the result receipt. The package format and password protection are owned by the work-data recovery modules; this source inventory does not certify them, so the copy is not labelled protected.

work-data-package-blob.purpose: Construct the explicit package download link
work-data-package-blob.productionRelation: work-data-settings.js savePackage createObjectURL and link.href from that URL only; revoked after one second
work-data-package-blob.evidence: 151 3F source review of the exact construction and assignment; the download itself is classified work-data-package-download.
